product_overview: idCashier is a comprehensive multi-tenant point-of-sale and business management application built with React and Supabase. It enables small to medium business owners to manage sales, inventory, employees, expenses, subscriptions, payments, and reporting efficiently within a unified dashboard.
core_goals: Provide a robust and secure user authentication system integrating login, registration, and password reset functionalities to protect user data.
Enable multi-tenant support to allow multiple businesses to operate independently with isolated data and configuration.
Offer comprehensive sales management features including product catalog CRUD, transaction handling, and receipt printing.
Facilitate employee management with roles, permissions, and attendance tracking to optimize workforce administration.
Support expense tracking and detailed business analytics through reporting dashboards for informed decision-making.
Integrate payment gateway for subscription management, renewals, and payment processing seamlessly.
Ensure a user-friendly interface with internationalization, dark/light theme modes, and responsive navigation for accessibility and usability.
key_features: Authentication system using Supabase Auth with login, registration, password resets, and session management.
Multi-tenancy architecture enabling isolated data stores per tenant for secure and scalable business management.
Dashboard with protected routes and navigation facilitating easy access to key business functions.
Sales management including point-of-sale transaction processing and product catalog management with CRUD operations.
Employee management featuring roles, permissions, and attendance tracking for efficient HR workflows.
Business expense management tools to log and track expenses effectively.
HPP (Cost of Goods) management incorporating raw materials, recipes, and custom cost calculations.
Payment integration through Duitku gateway supporting subscriptions and renewal payments.
Subscription and renewal management modules enabling easy billing cycles and payment status tracking.
Printing support for receipts, invoices, and delivery notes with configurable print styles.
Internationalization support with runtime language selection and translations to cater to multi-language audiences.
Theming system allowing users to toggle between dark and light modes for personalized UI experience.
Landing page and legal pages providing user-facing information and compliance documentation.
Developer tools and utilities including debugging interfaces and Supabase Edge Functions integration for backend operations.
user_flow_summary: User visits the landing page and can navigate to register or login pages.
New users register an account and set up a store in the multi-tenant environment.
Authenticated users access the dashboard with navigation to sales, products, employees, attendance, expenses, reports, payments, and settings.
Business owners manage product catalog by adding, updating, or removing products.
Managers handle employee information, assign roles and permissions, and monitor attendance records.
Users record sales transactions and issue receipts using the POS system.
Business expenses are added and categorized for tracking purposes.
Users view analytics and reports summarizing sales, expenses, and employee data for business insights.
Subscription management allows users to select plans, process payments through integrated gateway, and handle renewals.
Users customize application settings such as language preferences and UI themes.
Developers can utilize integrated tools and invoke Supabase Edge Functions for extended backend capabilities.
validation_criteria: Successful user registration, login, password reset, and session management with Supabase Auth.
Multi-tenancy data isolation verified by ensuring tenant-specific data access and store setup functionality.
CRUD operations on products reflect correctly in the product catalog and sales pages.
Employee role assignment and attendance tracking work as intended with appropriate permissions.
Sales transactions process correctly and generate printable receipts and invoices.
Expenses log accurately and are retrievable in reporting views.
Payment gateway integration is functional with subscription payment processing and renewal handling.
Localization features correctly display language translations and language selector updates UI dynamically.
Theme toggling between dark and light modes updates the UI and persists user preference.
All navigation flows maintain protected routes and user sessions without unauthorized access.
Landing and legal pages are accessible with correct content and links.
Developer tools and Supabase Edge Functions invoke successfully without errors.
